=== DONE (s473t5d) ===
FOUND + FIXED s473t5d (Opus, 2026-09-13) by #1501 round 5 CHECK 1.

t/run/switches.t aborted at

  run/switches.t: Failed to open 'tmpswitches.bak': No such file or directory

35 rows short.  The cause is the harness wrapper: `tools/pclperl-for-tests`
listed `-i[ext]` among the switches it "accepts and IGNORES" -- it consumed the
extension and did nothing -- so `runperl(switches => ['-pi.bak'], ...)` edited
nothing and wrote no backup.

perl's `-i` IS `$^I = "ext"` and nothing else, and PCL's `<>` already implements
in-place editing from that variable BYTE FOR BYTE (probed: two files, `$^I =
'.bak'`, `while(<>){s/foo/bar/} continue {print}` -- the main files and the
backups match perl exactly).  So the switch is ONE prelude line, which is the
rule-11 answer: reuse the mechanism, do not write a second one.

RESULT: t/run/switches.t 6/99 -> 28/112, shortfall 35 -> 11 (the residue is a
SECOND abort, #1699, fixed in the same batch, and then the file runs to its end).
Guard tools/t/harness-switches.t rows 1+2 (`-i.bak` leaves a backup, bare `-i`
does not); both FAIL on a `git archive 2ff53f8d` extraction.
subject: `tools/pclperl-for-tests -i[ext]` consumed the extension and did nothing; perl's -i IS `$^I = "ext"`, which PCL's <> already honours byte for byte
